owner: Claudio Terzi / interactive Vercel activation request
scope: Authenticated protected-preview fetches without a Porta session. No private response content, credentials or temporary access links retained here. Production unchanged and Vercel SSO retained.
cause: Vercel CLI 62.7.0 mergeRoutes puts user routes before project middleware routes. The existing terminal catch-all consumes the request first.
correction: Add an explicit catch-all middlewarePath route as the first user route, retaining the Node middleware builder and all existing content routes.
lesson: Builder output and green unit tests do not prove deployed middleware execution or route precedence. Require login, direct-file and API checks on the exact deployment before release.
next_gates: configuration validation and merged routing order
